## First public preview

Rei is an Electron desktop workspace for bingo. This preview bundles a platform-matching bingo runtime; existing bingo configuration remains owned by bingo.

### Included

- Conversations without a required project: start in a private temporary workspace, or attach a folder.
- Streaming responses, tool details, interactive approvals, conversation history and text drafts.
- Searchable model selection, reasoning-effort controls and English/Simplified Chinese UI.
- A right-side isolated browser, agent-generated ShowPage pages, and a real terminal below the workspace.
- Provider setup, system/light/dark appearance and a skippable reduced-motion-aware startup transition.

### Before installing

- **Preview quality; manual updates.** This is not a signed or notarized stable release. macOS and Windows may show publisher/security warnings. Verify downloads using `SHA256SUMS.txt`; do not disable system security globally.
- You still need to configure a model provider. Cloud OAuth/accounts were not exercised using real credentials in automated tests.
- **Windows is not at full agent-tool parity:** the GUI and embedded PowerShell terminal target Windows, but bingo's agent `Bash` tool is currently Unix-only. Do not rely on general agent shell-execution workflows on Windows.
- Agent child-task/approval dashboards, repository-wide change review and file navigation are not yet exposed. Interactive delegation workflows remain limited; use bingo's terminal interface when those controls are needed.
- Temporary-workspace files are not a permanent project location. Attach a project folder for work you want to keep there.
- The terminal runs your local shell with your user privileges. Browser pages are isolated from the application bridge and Node.js; normal web links open in-app, while sign-in has an explicit system-browser path.

Installer assets are published only after their corresponding build and automated checks succeed. Native CI checks do not replace hands-on device testing or an independent security audit.
